title: AI How-To Video Maker for Product Demos | AIVideosUGC
description: Turn one product photo into a how-to demo for Shorts and ads, with no presenter to film. Pick a tall 9:16 or a wide 16:9, at 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.
h1: AI How-To Video Maker for a Task You Can Follow
lead: Pick a how-to scene and add one photo, so the clip shows the task from the first step to the result. A voice, on-screen words (captions), or a generated person (an AI actor) can join the same file.
steps_h2: How to Make a Product How-To Video in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: You need one photo, one short task line, and a file you can post. The step shows how many credits it uses.

steps.d: Show the whole product, including the part that does the work. Keep every edge inside the frame.
Name the task and one change a shopper should see. Then pick a shape and a length from 6 to 30 seconds.
Download the file and add step labels in your own editor. Post it when the action matches the real product.

faq.q: What is an AI how-to video?
faq.a: It shows one task from the first move to the result. You can add an AI actor, a script, a voice, and captions. Start from a product photo or a product link.

faq.q: How do I make the how-to clip?
faq.a: Upload the photo, name the task, and pick a shape and a length. Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Shapes are tall phone 9:16, square 1:1, wide 16:9, slightly wide 4:3, and slightly tall 3:4.

faq.q: Why start here instead of filming a presenter?
faq.a: Try one version before you book a creator. Change the spoken line, the actor, or the language, and make another file. Check the action against the real product before you post.
Shops, agencies, and founders who need to show how a product works. You can make a first file without video editing experience.

faq.q: Can I do this on the first try?
faq.a: Yes. Upload one clear photo, describe the single task, and download the file. Type a price in your own editor after download, if the listing needs one.
A product photo, a short clip you already filmed, or a product page link. The task should match the real item.
Publish to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook in one step, or download a file for YouTube. Pick the video shape before you start.

A video costs 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, and 120 for 30. Starter is $24.50 a month with 200 credits. You see the cost before you start. If it fails, those credits come back. The download has no watermark.

faq.q: Can I run the file in ads?
faq.a: Yes. Use the download in your ads, pages, and posts. People on screen are AI actors, so present the clip as your shop's ad.

faq.q: Can I make several products at once?
faq.a: Yes. Run the same task on many photos at once, or start them from your own software (the API). Each one shows its credit cost first.

faq.q: Will the file speak the steps?
faq.a: Yes. Turn on an AI voice and captions so the steps are heard and read. You can still type a price in your own editor after download.
